section.content: 本实用新型适用于电池领域，提供种锂离子电池，包括电池框架、保护线路板以及卡接于所述电池框架内并与所述保护线路板相连的电芯，所述电池框架包括用于容纳所述电芯的主架体以及与所述主架体连接的端盖，所述端盖具有开口腔，所述开口腔的开口朝向所述主架体，所述端盖于所述开口腔内设有插槽，所述保护线路板插接于所述插槽，所述电芯与所述保护线路板电性连接。本实用新型通过在所述端盖的开口腔内设置插槽并将所述保护线路板插接于所述插槽内，实现了对所述保护线路板的固定支撑，不易松动，避免了通过独立设置的辅料来支撑所述保护线路板时造成的支撑不稳定的问题，且降低了加工成本，简化了加工工序，便于维修和更换。

The utility model is suitable for field of batteries; a kind of lithium ion battery is provided; including battery frame, protection circuit plate and the battery core for being connected in the battery frame and being connected with the protection circuit plate; the battery frame includes being used for the end cap for accommodating the main frame body of the battery core and being connected with the main frame body; the end cap has atrium; the opening of the atrium is towards the main frame body; the end cap is in being equipped with slot in the atrium; the protection circuit plate is plugged in the slot, and the battery core is electrically connected with the protection circuit plate.The utility model in the atrium of the end cap by setting slot and the protection circuit plate being plugged in the slot; realize and the fixed of the protection circuit plate is supported; it is not easy to loosen; the problem of support is unstable caused by when avoiding by independently arranged auxiliary material to support the protection circuit plate; and reduce processing cost; simplify manufacturing procedure, easy to repair and replacement.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

The utility model belongs to battery technology field, more particularly to a kind of lithium ion battery.

Background technology

At present, with the continuous improvement of people's material and cultural life and the fast development of electronics market, such as The raising of the various digital electronic goods performances such as smart mobile phone, digital camera, electronics bracelet table, DV, older mobile phone, children's wrist-watch The raising of increase and fraction defective with plant produced line manufacture cost.

In battery industry, in the market electronic product generally uses small lithium ion polymer battery.Existing small-sized lithium from Sub- polymer battery is mainly made of protection board, polymer battery core and frame, since the positive and negative anodes golden finger end of battery is just Face, is generally supported at the golden finger end of protection circuit plate by independently arranged auxiliary material, and generation that hardware sink is prevented with this, The assembling of battery is completed by low-pressure injection molding encapsulating again, but the support so caused to protection circuit plate is unstable, adds Work is of high cost, and the defects such as production operation complex procedures, efficiency is low.

Utility model content

The purpose of this utility model is to provide a kind of lithium ion battery, it is intended to solves in the prior art using being independently arranged Auxiliary material support unstable technical problem caused by supporting at the golden finger end of protection circuit plate.

The utility model is realized in this way a kind of lithium ion battery, including battery frame, protection circuit plate and with institute The battery core that protection circuit plate is connected is stated, the battery frame includes main frame body and the end cap being connected with the main frame body, described The U-shaped setting of main frame body, and enclosed jointly in the periphery of the battery core with the end cap, the end cap has notch towards body frame The slot of body, the protection circuit plate are plugged in the slot, and the battery core is electrically connected with the protection circuit plate.

Specifically, the protection circuit plate includes electrical input and the golden finger as electricity output end, the end cap Upper cover face has the through hole as electrode output window, the position of the through hole and size matching corresponding with the golden finger.

Specifically, the battery core includes main core body and electrode portion, the electrode portion protrude from the main core body and with electricity Input terminal is electrically connected.

Specifically, the end cap includes main cover body and the supporting structure being connected with the main cover body, and the main cover body opens up There is atrium of the opening towards the main frame body, the atrium has the first cavity wall and the second cavity wall being oppositely arranged, described Supporting structure is connected to first cavity wall, and is collectively forming the slot with second cavity wall.

Specifically, the first support plate and two for the dorsal part that the supporting structure includes being resisted against the golden finger supports respectively The second support plate in the protection circuit plate both ends

Specifically, the strut angle of the supporting structure for forming the slot is arranged to fillet.

Specifically, the battery core further includes at least one side wall for being arranged at the main core body and is used for and the main frame body The elastic component of clamping.

Specifically, the elastic component is the elastic piece that cross section is V-type.

Specifically, the upper end of the main frame body offers the pickup mouth that the battery core is taken for unloading downwards.

Specifically, the lithium ion battery further includes the package board and package for encapsulating the battery core.

The utility model has the technical effect that relative to the prior art：The utility model passes through the atrium in the end cap The protection circuit plate is simultaneously plugged in the slot by interior setting slot, realizes the fixed branch to the protection circuit plate Support, is not easy to loosen, and support is unstable caused by when avoiding by independently arranged auxiliary material to support the protection circuit plate Problem, and processing cost is reduced, simplify manufacturing procedure, easy to repair and replacement.
